definitions.explanation: A group of criminals who work together, especially in the context of American or Western-style organized crime.
An individual member of a criminal gang. Often evokes the image of American gangsters from movies and media.

notes:
From English "gang" / "gangster." In Japanese, ギャング typically evokes Western-style organized crime (especially American), as distinct from Japanese organized crime. Japanese crime syndicates are referred to as ⟦{暴力団|ぼうりょくだん}→暴力団：13025_bouryokudan⟧ or ヤクザ, not ギャング.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ギャング⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧: gangster movie
- ギャング⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧: gang (group)
- ギャング⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ボス→ボス：11269_bosu⟧: gang boss
- ギャング⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{抗争|こうそう}→抗争：15555_kousou⟧: gang conflict/warfare
- ギャング⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{縄張|なわば}り→縄張り：09337_nawabari⟧: gang territory

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ヤクザ: yakuza — Japanese organized crime members; carries distinct cultural connotations
- ⟦{暴力団|ぼうりょくだん}→暴力団：13025_bouryokudan⟧: crime syndicate — the formal/legal term for organized crime groups in Japan
- マフィア: mafia — specifically Italian/Sicilian-style organized crime
